AI tools (like Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code or Cursor) connect through greenshot-mcp, which comes with %@. They can list your windows, take screenshots and run your recipes. While this is off, Greenshot refuses every request without asking. Each program still needs your permission the first time it connects.
column2: Orodja UI (kot so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code ali Cursor) se povežejo prek greenshot-mcp, ki je priložen programu %@. Lahko prikažejo seznam vaših oken, ustvarjajo posnetke zaslona in zaganjajo vaše recepte. Ko je to izklopljeno, Greenshot zavrne vsako zahtevo brez vprašanja. Vsak program še vedno potrebuje vaše dovoljenje ob prvi povezavi.

column1: Word, PowerPoint and Outlook insert into a new document, presentation or mail, or one that is open (the destination menu lists them). Excel inserts into the active sheet of an open or a new workbook. Outlook attaches the screenshot and uses the Email section's subject, To, CC and BCC; with “allow export in meeting items” it also lists the open meetings you organise and attaches the screenshot to the meeting. New Outlook can't be scripted. OneNote for Mac can't be scripted either: Notes takes its place (or use Open With). On a layout without a picture placeholder the screenshot is centred on the slide; a layout PowerPoint refuses gives a blank slide.
column2: Word, PowerPoint in Outlook vstavijo v nov dokument, predstavitev ali e-pošto ali v odprto (meni ciljev jih navede). Excel vstavi v aktivni list odprtega ali novega delovnega zvezka. Outlook priloži posnetek zaslona in uporabi zadevo, Za, CC in BCC iz razdelka E-pošta; z »dovoli izvoz v elemente sestankov« navede tudi odprte sestanke, ki jih organizirate, in posnetek zaslona priloži sestanku. Novega Outlooka ni mogoče skriptirati. Tudi OneNote za Mac ni mogoče skriptirati: nadomesti ga Notes (ali uporabite Odpri z). Pri postavitvi brez označbe mesta za sliko je posnetek zaslona na sredini diapozitiva; postavitev, ki jo PowerPoint zavrne, da prazen diapozitiv.

macOS asks every app that takes screenshots for this permission.

Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, turn on %@, then quit and reopen it.

Not in the list? Click + below it and add %@ from Applications.

Already on? A rebuilt or moved copy counts as a new app: select it, remove it with −, then reopen %@ and allow it again.

macOS zahteva to dovoljenje od vsake aplikacije, ki ustvarja posnetke zaslona.

Odprite Sistemske nastavitve › Zasebnost in varnost › Snemanje zaslona in zvoka sistema, vklopite %@, nato ga zaprite in znova odprite.

Že vklopljeno? Znova zgrajena ali premaknjena kopija velja za novo aplikacijo: izberite jo, odstranite z −, nato znova odprite %@ in jo ponovno dovolite.
